This morning, message for families

Please give it some attention

Travel notice for pet passengers

Travelers need to review the companion animal steps before departure so the check-in process stays smooth and your pet has the right support.

Please bring any health papers, feeding notes, and comfort items that your animal uses at home. The cabin team monitors animals during flight, and care plans should reflect species, temperament, and comfort. <<FACT F002>> Keep carriers secure, clean, and clearly labeled, and follow staff directions at every stage. <<FACT F025>>

When you arrive, allow extra breathing room for pet checks and stay with your animal until a staff member gives the next instruction. <<FACT F017>> If your trip includes a transfer, use the same carrier and keep documents ready for inspection. Report any change in behavior, food needs, or medical care as soon as possible.

For help with preparation, arrival steps, or in-flight pet support, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
